donors.name: agent-slop-lint
donors.notes: Permissive donor with a strict live-oracle adapter. The harness imports the locked checkout through a pre-provisioned Python environment and generates atomic source cases at test time.

donors.name: Rust Clippy
donors.notes: Optional installed oracle for Rust static-analysis calibration; not required for normal scans.

donors.name: Ruff (Python linter)
donors.notes: Rust-native Python linter. Adopt complexity algorithm and naming conventions. MIT license permits direct algorithm port.

donors.name: ESLint (JavaScript/TypeScript linter)
donors.notes: Dominant JS/TS linter. Parity reference for EA structural detectors. SonarJS cognitive complexity and import/no-cycle algorithms worth adopting.

donors.name: Semgrep (multi-language pattern matching)
donors.notes: Language-parametric pattern engine. Reference only — LGPL-2.1 and OCaml engine make direct porting impractical. Study for future custom-rule feature.

donors.name: PMD (Java static analysis + CPD)
donors.notes: CPD (Copy-Paste Detector) is algorithmically superior to EA's file-fingerprint approach. Adopt token-based duplication detection algorithm.

donors.name: Detekt (Kotlin static analysis)
donors.notes: Cleanest open-source cognitive complexity implementation. Adopt algorithm as a separate EA detector.

donors.name: Golangci-Lint (Go meta-linter)
donors.notes: GPL-3.0 — no direct porting. Study parallel execution and deduplication architecture only.

donors.name: Pylint (Python static analysis)
donors.notes: GPL-2.0 — no direct porting. Symilar token-based duplication algorithm may be worth clean-room reimplementation.

donors.name: JSCPD (copy-paste detector)
donors.notes: Token-based duplication detection with per-language tokenizers. MIT license. Adopt algorithm for EA's source_duplicate_group improvement.

donors.name: Deptrac (PHP architectural dependency checker)
donors.notes: Architectural layering model is language-agnostic. Adopt concept for EA L4 systems engineering expansion.

donors.name: Bandit (Python security linter)
donors.notes: Security-focused correctness rules. Adopt assert_used, exec_used, eval patterns for EA L1 correctness detectors.

donors.name: Import Linter (Python architecture contracts)
donors.notes: Live version-checked forbidden-layer contract oracle. No source is linked into production crates; atomic parity compares native output on the same generated Python project.

donors.name: Dependency Cruiser (JavaScript/TypeScript architecture rules)
donors.notes: Live version-checked cycle-rule oracle. No source is linked into production crates; atomic parity compares native JSON on the same generated JavaScript project.
